title: Open Speculative Model Configuration
description: Schema for a DFlash speculative decoding draft model configuration. Architecture-specific model fields are accepted but not validated by Open Spec Config.

open_spec_config_version.description: Version of the Open Spec Config format. Each schema release validates exactly one version.

architectures.description: Model implementation class that loads this configuration. DFlash checkpoints use DflashDraftModel.

speculative_config.description: Speculative decoding settings: shared metadata plus DFlash-specific fields. Each speculative method has its own standalone schema, so unknown fields are rejected.

method.description: Speculative decoding algorithm identifier. This schema supports DFlash.

speculative_tokens.description: Maximum number of candidate tokens the draft model can propose for verification in one decoding step, excluding the existing anchor. At runtime may request fewer tokens.

verifier.description: Optional model identifier for the verifier model.

target_layer_ids.description: Verifier hidden-state layer indices consumed by the draft model.

items.description: A verifier layer index interpreted according to target_layer_start_idx.

target_layer_start_idx.description: Index of the first target layer used by the draft model. 0 or 1.

draft_vocab_size.description: Optional size of the reduced vocabulary used by the draft model.

sample_from_anchor.description: Whether token sampling may start from the anchor token.

mask_token_id.description: Vocabulary ID of the mask token used during draft generation.

sliding_window_non_causal.description: Whether draft sliding-window attention may attend non-causally within its window.

training_framework.description: Framework used to train the draft model, as a GitHub org/repo, e.g. vllm-project/speculators or sgl-project/SpecForge. Lets a checkpoint be traced back to its training framework, since the same drafter can perform differently across inference engines depending on where it was trained.

additionalProperties.description: Architecture-specific base-model configuration property, such as a Qwen3Config constructor argument. Open Spec Config does not define or validate these properties.
